tasks.prompt: Describe a place in your town or city where people go to relax. What do people do there, and why do they like it? Include specific details.
tasks.follow_up: Some people think that cities should turn more streets and parking spaces into parks. Would this be a good idea for the place where you live? Explain why or why not.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.text: Hey, Sam. Are you still in the study group for the economics exam?

conversation.speaker: student2
conversation.text: I am, but honestly, I'm thinking about leaving it.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.text: Really? Why? I thought it was going well.

conversation.speaker: student2
conversation.text: We meet on Wednesday nights, and I started a new job at the café. My shifts end at nine.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.text: Oh, that's a problem. We usually start at seven.

conversation.speaker: student2
conversation.text: Right. And I don't want to slow everyone down by missing half of every session.

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.text: What if we moved the meeting to Sunday afternoon? Most of us are free then, I think.

conversation.speaker: student2
conversation.text: Sunday would work for me. But would the others agree?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.text: I'll send a message to the group tonight and ask. If two people say no, we could also try a video call on Wednesdays after nine.

conversation.speaker: student2
conversation.text: That sounds fair. Thanks for trying. I really don't want to study for this exam alone.

tasks.prompt: Many people now read news and books on their phones instead of on paper. Is this change good or bad for readers? Give reasons and examples for your answer.
Talk about a time when you worked with other people to finish a difficult task.
bullets: What did you do in the group?
What would you do differently next time?

questions: I'd like to talk with you about volunteering. Have you ever done volunteer work, or do you know someone who has?
I see. Why do you think some people give their free time to help others without pay?
Interesting. Should schools require students to do volunteer work? Why or why not?
Thanks. Now let's change topics and talk about sleep. How many hours do you usually sleep, and is it enough for you?
I see. What keeps people from getting enough sleep these days?
Thanks. One last question. Should companies and universities start their day later so that people can sleep more? Explain your answer.

tasks.prompt: Describe a decision that you made which changed your life in an important way. What were the choices, why did you choose as you did, and what happened as a result?
